Existing pickup order #1007 (already at Picked Up terminal) shows 'Pickup' badge; drawer status buttons for pickup order: [New, Confirmed, Preparing, Ready, Picked Up] — no 'Out for Delivery', no 'Delivered'. Delivery order drawer #1014: [New, Confirmed, Preparing, Ready, Out for Delivery, Delivered] — no 'Picked Up'. Source lib/orderStatus.ts confirms PICKUP_LABEL never maps to 'Dispatch rider'. ADMIN FORCED-CHANGE: admin biit20267511@biit.edu.pk had must_change_password=false in DB (backend pytest suite already flipped it earlier today, credentials_updated_at=14:11). Temporarily set must_change_password=true in Mongo, logged in with ChangeMe@2026 → redirected to /change-password, forced-change-notice visible, heading 'Set a new password'. Navigating to /admin while forced correctly redirected back to /change-password. change-password-logout button logged out to /login (password NOT changed). Restored must_change_password=false in DB.
